content_text:
Of course everything is on a spectrum, it’s not like the choice is between anamorphic lenses with zero anamorphic artifacts versus the funkiest, oldest, more flarey and distorted anamorphic lenses ever made.  But it seems to me that one would want
some
anamorphic artifacts, even if subtle, if you were going to pick anamorphic — if
all
you want is a 2.40 frame, there are easier, simpler, cheaper ways of getting there.
